title: Recursive catalog cost
statement: For natural numbers $q,C$, define a function $T:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ recursively by $T(0)=C+1$ and $T(r+1)=q(T(r)+2)+q+2$ for every $r\in\mathbb{N}$.
